record_scope_reconstruction: Renewed international freight obstruction at Paso Canoas 21–24 October 2020 triggered by Panamanian truck protocols; separate earlier October protest not merged.

source_checks.finding: TVN 24 October reports freight flowing again Saturday morning after over three days, agreement on loaded entry and empty return, and SENAFRONT reopening processing.
Presidency 14 October records an earlier reopening; not sufficient to close or date the later 21 October phase.
